Package dev.px.core.hud

Class HudEditor

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.hud.HudEditor
public final class HudEditor extends Object
Edit mode: select, drag, scale, lock, hide and reorder HUD elements.

Input arrives through Core's ordinary MouseEvent, KeyEvent and ScrollEvent at Priority.HIGHEST, and every one of them is cancelled while the editor is open. That cancellation is the "swallows input" requirement: with the events consumed before anything else sees them, no module toggles and no gameplay action can fire behind the editor.

Selection outlines are drawn by asking the element's own Shape to Shape.stroke(float, dev.px.core.render.Color). Nothing here switches on shape type, so a circular or polygonal element gets a correct outline and correct hit testing on the day it is written.

Dragging follows the mouse from Platform.getMouseX() each frame rather than from a move event, because Core has no mouse-move event and does not need one: the drag is only interesting while something is being drawn.

    • close

      public void close()
      Leaves edit mode and drops all transient state.

      Note that while the editor is open it cancels every key, which includes whatever bind opened it. ESCAPE is therefore the way out: it clears the selection if there is one, and closes the editor otherwise.
